name: RedM
author: NodeByteHosting
description: RedM server (RDR2 multiplayer) with txAdmin. Uses the FiveM Legacy server download.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RedM Installation Script - NodeByte Hosting
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update -y
apt install -y tar xz-utils curl git file jq unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

RELEASE_PAGE=$(curl -sSL https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/)
CHANGELOGS_PAGE=$(curl -sSL https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server)

if [ ! -d "./alpine/" ] && [ ! -d "./resources/" ]; then
  echo "Beginning installation of new RedM server."
  IS_UPDATE=0
else
  echo "Beginning update of existing RedM FXServer artifact."
  IS_UPDATE=1
  if [ -d "./alpine/" ]; then
    echo "Deleting old FXServer artifact..."
    rm -rf ./alpine/
    echo "Deleted old FXServer artifact files successfully."
  fi
fi

if [[ "${REDM_VERSION}" == "recommended" ]] || [[ -z "${REDM_VERSION}" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo "$CHANGELOGS_PAGE" | jq -r '.recommended_download')
elif [[ "${REDM_VERSION}" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo "$CHANGELOGS_PAGE" | jq -r '.latest_download')
elif [[ "${REDM_VERSION}" == http* ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_LINK="${REDM_VERSION}"
else
  VERSION_PATH=$(echo "${RELEASE_PAGE}" | grep -oE "build_proot_linux/master/[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]+\/" | grep "${REDM_VERSION}" | head -n 1)
  if [ -n "${VERSION_PATH}" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/${VERSION_PATH}fx.tar.xz"
  elif [[ "${REDM_VERSION}" == *"-"* ]]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/${REDM_VERSION}/fx.tar.xz"
  else
    echo "Could not resolve build ${REDM_VERSION}. Defaulting to recommended."
    DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(echo "$CHANGELOGS_PAGE" | jq -r '.recommended_download')
  fi
fi

echo -e "Downloading artifact from: ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
curl -sSL "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" -o fx.tar.xz

echo "Extracting RedM FXServer artifact files..."
FILETYPE=$(file -b --mime-type fx.tar.xz)

if [[ "$FILETYPE" == *"x-xz"* ]] || [[ "$FILETYPE" == *"octet-stream"* ]]; then
  tar xvf fx.tar.xz
elif [[ "$FILETYPE" == *"gzip"* ]]; then
  tar xzvf fx.tar.xz
elif [[ "$FILETYPE" == *"zip"* ]]; then
  unzip fx.tar.xz
else
  echo -e "Downloaded artifact of unknown filetype ($FILETYPE). Exiting."
  rm -f fx.tar.xz
  exit 2
fi

rm -f fx.tar.xz run.sh

if [ "$IS_UPDATE" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ -e server.cfg ]; then
    echo "Server config file already exists. Skipping download of new one."
  else
    echo "Downloading default RedM server config..."
    curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodebytehosting/recipes/develop/games/rockstar/redm/server.cfg >> server.cfg
  fi
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/resources
  echo "Preparing to clone default RedM resources."
  git clone https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data.git /tmp/cfx-resources
  cp -Rf /tmp/cfx-resources/resources/* resources/
  rm -rf /tmp/cfx-resources
  grep -q '^set gamename' server.cfg || echo 'set gamename rdr3' >> server.cfg
  mkdir -p logs/
  echo "Installation complete."
else
  echo "Update complete."
fi

variables.name: Cfx.re license key
variables.description: Required to start the server. Get your key at https://portal.cfx.re/

variables.name: Server version
variables.description: Set to "recommended", "latest", a build number or a direct download URL. RedM uses the FiveM Legacy server download. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: Require Steam login
variables.description: Only let players join if their Steam account is linked to their Cfx.re account. Needs server version 38004 or newer.

variables.name: Enable txAdmin
variables.description: Run txAdmin on the second port and manage the server from there.
